fusions.name: Remedial Lesson
fusions.desc: A rap that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it a [Slow Learner] for 8 seconds: your thorns bite it deeper, and barriers it strikes grow stronger. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Marginal Notes
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away and deals 28 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It ignores resistances, and its damage rises 15% for each of your afflictions on the target (max 60%).

fusions.name: Economy of Motion
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Another Pass
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
